recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist composition featuring a small, centered rectangular photograph of a group of people in a dark urban setting, surrounded by a vast expanse of off-white negative space, topped with a thin chartreuse header bar containing condensed sans-serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: Small central focal point against expansive negative space
High-contrast dark photo vs. light cream background
Vibrant chartreuse header bar as a structural anchor
Symmetrical text placement within the top horizontal band
coreInvariants: Thin horizontal bar at the very top edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The photographic subject is positioned in the exact center, occupying approximately 15% of the total canvas area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The chartreuse header bar at the top provides a horizontal anchor that balances the central vertical weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the vibrant top bar, drops down to the central image, and then rests in the surrounding negative space.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant; approximately 80% of the composition is empty cream space.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the top bar contrasts with the desaturated, low-key lighting of the central photograph.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with varying alignment to create internal rhythm.
graphicDevices: Thin black border around central image

avoid: Centered text in the middle of the page

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed verticality of the original.
Provides a cleaner, more modernist look with similar proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a large square canvas in a solid off-white cream color. Add a thin chartreuse green horizontal bar at the top edge. In the exact center, place a small rectangular photograph of four men in a dark, grainy, 1980s-style street scene with moody lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using an extra-condensed bold sans-serif font in dark brown, place text inside the chartreuse bar. Center one phrase and align another phrase to the right, leaving a small margin from the edge.

verificationChecks: Is the central image small enough to create significant negative space?
Is the top bar a vibrant chartreuse green?
Is the font extra-condensed and all-caps?
Is the background a warm off-white rather than pure white?

adjustableVariables: Width of the top header bar
Specific shade of the background cream
Specific shade of the chartreuse accent
mustRedesign: Exact brand names or band names

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on the header bar
High-quality film grain texture in the photo

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible within the narrow top bar.
Check that the central image has a thin black border.
Verify the negative space feels intentional and balanced.
Confirm the color palette remains limited to cream, green, and dark photo tones.
recipe.reuseFormula: Centralized small-scale imagery + dominant negative space + top-weighted color accent bar = Minimalist Indie Aesthetic.
